Confluence and Zulip evidence show this issue belonged to a broader family/household Group policy cluster and support the same limited guidance that current source carries. Later ServiceRequest edits have not removed the Group targets or limiting comments.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. The current authoritative StructureDefinition already includes Group on both target profile lists, the family/household-only and practitioner-group exclusion comments, and the supporting mapping exceptions.
